# Farm for sale

> Daniel Fleming Auctioneers are pleased to present this c.29 acre farm, currently in grass with a residence in need of attention (will be suitable for the vacant/derelict homes grants). To include a farmyard with slatted units and a number of stone outbuildings. This farm can be sold in one or more lots to suit.
